title: Easy Recovery Flow - Mobility & Active Restoration

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly through each rep, focusing on spinal articulation. Inhale on cow, exhale on cat. Feel the gentle mobilization of your spine.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Extend opposite arm and leg slowly, maintaining a neutral spine. Pause for 1 second at full extension. This activates your core gently.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Rotate gently between hip positions. Move with control and breathe steadily. This prepares hips for the longer race training ahead.

items.name: Adductor Rockbacks
items.cues: Rock back slowly, feeling a gentle stretch in the adductors. Keep tension low (RPE 3-4). Breathe steadily throughout.

items.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization
items.cues: Flex your ankles through full range of motion. Important for 45km endurance event - keep ankles mobile and healthy. Move smoothly.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold a deep but comfortable calf stretch. Lean gently into the wall. Hold for 60 seconds each side. No bouncing.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Place forearm against wall at shoulder height. Gently rotate body away. Hold 60 seconds, breathing deeply. Promotes shoulder recovery.

items.name: Butterfly Sit-Up
items.cues: Perform slow, controlled sit-ups in butterfly position. Keep motion smooth and relaxed. This gently engages core while stretching hip flexors.

items.name: Child's Pose Hold
items.cues: Hold child's pose for 2 minutes with slow, deep breathing. Focus on relaxation and recovery. This completes your active recovery session.

rationale: After 3 consecutive high-intensity endurance sessions (70min, RPE 6-7) and 2 strength sessions, this recovery workout is essential to manage fatigue and prepare for race-specific training with 20 days until Engelbrektsloppet 45km.

Recovery day prioritizes mobility work in hips, ankles, and shoulders that support ultra-distance running, using low-intensity (RPE 4-5) exercises that promote blood flow and reduce soreness without adding training stress.

The 30-minute gentle flow respects your advanced fitness level while allowing active recovery—lighter movement accelerates adaptation and prevents overtraining as you enter the final 3 weeks before your 45km race.
